body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Psychic Damage and make it Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, impose -1 on its next Success Die until the start of your next turn.
Knock the target Prone on a hit.

rider.title: Strain - Fracture
rider.html: If you accepted Strain and hit, the target must burn 1 die before standing from Prone or ending an ordinary restraint before your next turn; this is an added cost, not a canceled Action.
